report.clinical_summary: Patient with HIV diagnosed 3 years ago presents with fatigue and headaches that have worsened recently, impacting work and daily responsibilities. Viral load is detectable at 340 copies/mL with CD4 count of 410 cells/uL. Currently on Triumeq (abacavir/dolutegravir/lamivudine) once daily but misses doses 2-3 times per week and takes breaks when feeling well. Patient understands mechanism of action and importance of adherence but has concerns about potential side effects and questions whether medication is worth it. No other symptoms of active viral replication.
